Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child?s very existence.

today.title: Arnie and Barney

today.title: Heart Of The Beast

today.title: The Social Reckoning

today.title: Verity
